title: Unraveling the significance of Raman modes, Gruneisen parameters and phonon lifetimes in the hexagonal allotropes of Silicon and Germanium compounds
summary: Advancement in quantum information and quantum technologies has ushered in a new era of technological revolution in large scale atomistic simulation and efficient system on a chip device fabrication. This has led to innovative ways of harnessing rigorous search algorithms for functional quantum materials and steered scientists to dig deeper into the world of quantum phenomenon and applications.
